minor.author: agent@vielzeug
minor.comment: Greenfield API pass: presence/warnings/rejections move from onX callbacks to tap() with TavernHostEvent/TavernGuestEvent, host gains a peers getter, post-dispose use throws TavernDisposedError, rejections carry commandId

minor.author: agent@vielzeug
minor.comment: feat(tavern): initial release: host-owned session replication over mesh

minor.author: agent@vielzeug
minor.comment: Host sessions are now observable end-to-end: onEnded fires exactly once on both handles (subject removal and explicit disposal), handles expose disposed/disposalSignal/Symbol.dispose per the disposal contract, every unusable pasted code rejects with cause-chained TavernPairingError (mesh errors no longer leak across the boundary), failed joins tear down their node, onFailed no longer double-fires, a throwing snapshot read routes through onWarning, and error classes follow the repo template with correct names

patch.author: agent@vielzeug
patch.comment: Pairing-code handling simplified: meshQrCodec owns the CompressionStream fallback, so tavern calls it directly instead of wrapping both codecs in try/catch
